g.text: 328 hand-labelled cards across 9 checks of the LLM pipeline

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Labelled on private labelling pages with the answer key kept out of the page, cards in seeded random order, labels read back by code. These are sampled checks (validations, audits, spot checks): not every plotted

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: estimate has its own. The Haiku vs Sonnet judge test reused 85 of these cards and is not counted again.
